claims.claim_text: The indexed Frank G. Burford is confirmed as the Army entrant represented by the exact-name and private-identifier match in the official merged file.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact full name, middle initial, and private identifier match across the OSS index and official Army-entry file; the identifier is withheld.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact private identifier and exact normalized full name.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army-entry record is dated March 20, 1944; the index does not provide an OSS transfer date.
claims.match_notes: Namesakes lacking the private identifier or Box 93 linkage were rejected.

claims.claim_text: At Army entry, Frank G. Burford was recorded in the radio-operator occupational group.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official record carries code 061, which NARA's corrected list maps to radio operators.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact private identifier and full indexed name.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded to Army entry on March 20, 1944; the relation to OSS recruitment is unknown.
claims.match_notes: No employer, station, military branch, duties, workplace, or immediate OSS predecessor is inferred.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index preserves Lucien Bureau as a French sub-lieutenant in Box 93. A discovery-only wartime-mission compilation supplied a possible alias lead but no private identifier, Box 93 linkage, or second independent corroborating identifier; it is not published as a resolved identity.
person_updates.next_action: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed. Review Box 93 to resolve the possible alias, French service, OSS chronology, and pre-OSS affiliation.

research_attempts.query_text: Lucien Bureau: visually checked NARA OSS index; official Army, CIA, and Library of Congress checks; exact-name, French rank, aliases, OSS, employment, occupation, resistance, mission, newspaper, directory, and archival searches.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: A discovery-only mission compilation supplied a possible alias but no private identifier, Box 93 linkage, or second independent corroborating identifier; unrelated namesakes and surname-only results were rejected.
research_attempts.research_notes: The French sub-lieutenant classification is preserved from the index; the alias lead remains unconfirmed and no employer is published.
research_attempts.next_action: Review Box 93 to resolve the possible alias, French service, and pre-OSS affiliation.

research_attempts.query_text: Frank G. Burford: visually checked NARA OSS index; exact private-identifier Army check; CIA and Library of Congress checks; exact-name, OSS, employment, occupation, radio, institutional, newspaper, obituary, directory, genealogy-lead, and archival searches.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Genealogy and namesake results lacked the private identifier, Box 93 linkage, or two corroborating identifiers beyond the name.
research_attempts.research_notes: The exact Army record supports identity and a dated radio-operator occupation only; no employer was inferred.
research_attempts.next_action: Review Box 93 for employer and Army-to-OSS chronology.
